name: The first round
when: rung 2 and a man of nerve on the board (week three)

steps.verb: sign the parade's shops to a weekly round (Laverack's, the grocer, the newsagent, the launderette, the ironmonger, the Copper Kettle)

keys.how: a fair price, 10 pounds a shop, and a man who turns up
a squeeze, 25 to 40 pounds a shop (shops refuse and tell after three weeks)
a favour done first (a window mended, a thief caught)

steps.verb: a crewman of nerve collects on Fridays

pay.note: per shop per week; the man's cut a quarter (ECONOMY 5.1, EC-06); rung 3 needs a front and a round

src: ECONOMY 5.1, EC-06; STORY-FRAME 5 table week 3; BLUEPRINT-03 3.5.2 (later a crewman does rounds)
